meta.title: Menu Items for a Category of Articles
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Menu Items for a Category of Articles".

steps.title: Company Overview
steps.text: We are a company dedicated to providing quality products and services to our customers.

steps.title: Meet the Team
steps.text: Our team brings together experienced professionals from across the industry, united by a shared commitment to quality.

steps.title: Our Locations
steps.text: We operate offices in multiple cities, each staffed by local experts ready to help.

steps.title: Our Mission
steps.text: Our mission is to deliver reliable products and outstanding service to every customer we serve.

steps.title: Our History
steps.text: Founded with a commitment to quality, our company has grown steadily while staying true to its founding values.

UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Menu Items for a Category of Articles', 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item', '

A menu item can show all articles of a category at once. In this tour you make two of them for the category Company:

  • Company Articles Blog, a Category Blog: each article with its title, details and text
  • Company Articles List, a Category List: a simple list of titles

The category Company holds Company Overview, Our Mission and Our History.

This tour follows the tutorial 2.3 Menu items for a Category of Articles of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_menus","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 2.3 Menu items for a Category of Articles', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Menus', '

In the menu on the left, click Menus.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Menus › Main Menu', '

Click Main Menu in Menus.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Create a new menu item', '

This list holds the links of the Main Menu of your site.

Click New.

', 3, 'bottom', '.view-items .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Give the menu item a title', '

Type a title for the menu item, for example:

Company Articles Blog

When you have typed it, click Next.

', 4, 'bottom', '.view-item #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Choose the Menu Item Type', '
  1. Click Select.
  2. In the window that opens, click Articles, then Category Blog.

The page reloads. When the field shows Category Blog, click Next.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-item .input-group:has(#jform_type)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Choose the category', '
  1. At Choose a Category, click Select.
  2. In the window that opens, click Company.

Then click Next.

', 6, 'bottom', '.view-item .input-group:has(#jform_request_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Save the menu item', '

Click Save & Close.

', 7, 'bottom', 'body.view-item:has(#jform_link[value*="layout=blog"]) #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Look at the blog', '

Your menu item is now in the Main Menu.

Look at your site: click the button with your site\'s name in the header at the top (in the Joomla Playground you can also click Site in its toolbar). Click Company Articles Blog in the Main Menu.

You see the three articles of Company, and links to the sub-categories Team and Locations. Then come back here and click Next.

', 8, 'top', '#menuitemList tbody tr:last-child', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Now a list', '

The same category can also be shown as a simple list. Click New.

Type the title:

Company Articles List

Then click Next.

  1. Click Select.
  2. In the window that opens, click Articles, then Category List.

The page reloads. When the field shows Category List, click Next.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-item .input-group:has(#jform_type)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Choose the category', '
  1. At Choose a Category, click Select.
  2. In the window that opens, click Company.

Then click Next.

', 12, 'bottom', '.view-item .input-group:has(#jform_request_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Save the menu item', '

Click Save & Close.

', 13, 'bottom', 'body.view-item:has(#jform_link[value*="view=category"]:not([value*="layout=blog"])) #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category-menu-item'), 'Well done!', '

The Main Menu now shows the category Company in two ways.

Look at your site again and click Company Articles List in the Main Menu: the same articles, as a list of titles. Click a title to read the article.

Company Overview can now be reached three ways: through About Us, the blog and the list.

', 14, 'top', '#menuitemList tbody tr:last-child', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
